chunks: He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, who reported from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, from his father, who said: The one who heard Hannan ibn Sadir al-Sayrafi narrated to me, saying:

I saw the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, in a dream, and before him was a bowl covered with a cloth. I came closer and greeted him, he returned my greeting. Then he removed the cloth from the bowl, and behold, it was filled with fresh dates. He began to eat. I came closer and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, give me a date.' He gave me one and I ate it. Then I said: 'Give me another.' He gave it to me and I ate it. Every time I ate one, I asked for another, until he gave me eight fresh dates. I ate them, then asked for another. He said: 'Enough for you.'

He said: I woke up from my sleep. The next day, I visited al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, and before him was a bowl covered with a cloth, as though it was the same one I had seen in my dream before the Prophet. I greeted him and he returned my greeting. Then he uncovered the bowl, and behold, fresh dates. He began to eat. I was amazed and said: 'May I be your ransom, give me a date.' He gave me one and I ate it. Then I asked for another, he gave me and I ate. I went on asking until I ate eight fresh dates. Then I asked for another, and he said: 'If my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah, had given you more, I would have given you more too.' So I told him the story, and he smiled the smile of one who knew what had happened.

key_terms.تبسم عارف: The smile of one who knows - indicating supernatural awareness
key_terms.جعلت فداك: May I be your ransom - a reverential expression of devotion used toward the Imams
key_terms.حسبك: Enough for you - an expression indicating sufficiency
key_terms.رطب: Fresh dates (rutab) - ripe, soft dates, considered a blessed food in Islamic tradition
key_terms.طبق: Bowl or tray - a serving vessel

ai.seo_question: What is the story of Hannan ibn Sadir's dream about the Prophet and Imam al-Sadiq with dates?
ai.summary: Hannan ibn Sadir al-Sayrafi recounts a remarkable dream in which the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) gave him eight fresh dates from a covered bowl. The next day, he visited Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and found the exact same scene replicated. The Imam gave him exactly eight dates and when asked for more, revealed his knowledge of the dream by saying he would have given more only if the Prophet had. This narrative demonstrates the Imam's supernatural knowledge and his spiritual connection to the Prophet.
